errors.text: The Cr addition is not quantitatively specified; the target intervention is approximately 4.2 at.% Cr introduced by vacuum arc melting.
No mechanistic mediator is proposed: the reticulated approximately 4 vol.% Laves phase, BCC lattice contraction, solid-solution hardening, and crack-hindrance mechanism are omitted.

The claimed preservation or improvement of high-temperature performance is unsupported because neither a test temperature nor loading mode is specified, and the target result concerns room-temperature compression.
The experiment lacks quantitative rejection criteria and does not explicitly measure density, phase fraction and morphology, lattice parameter, yield strength, or fracture strain.
The cited evidence is mostly indirect or irrelevant to HfMoTaTiZr-Cr; only E1 weakly supports Cr-induced Laves-phase formation and hardening in a different coating system.
